faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Atherton?
faq.answer: Atherton homeowners typically invest $18,000 to $45,000+ for a full window replacement project. Estate homes on the town's large lots often have 20–35+ windows, many requiring custom sizing and premium finishes. Projects featuring Marvin Ultimate or Andersen A-Series with bronze hardware and specialty glazing packages can exceed $60,000 for larger properties.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Atherton?
faq.answer: Yes. Atherton requires building permits for all window replacement projects. Our team handles all permit applications and coordinates directly with Atherton's Building Department. Estate homes may also require architectural plans demonstrating that replacement windows match the property's approved design character.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Atherton?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Atherton commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Atherton?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Atherton replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Atherton?
faq.answer: Most Atherton projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
